recipe.name: feed-canary (Laravel 13 + Horizon, DDEV)
evidence: build is empty on purpose: the workflow never builds assets, it goes from composer install straight to the gates
All commands run through DDEV; host php and composer are deliberately absent
start/port deliberately null: DDEV serves host-routed HTTPS via a router, so a plain-HTTP probe against 127.0.0.1 would record a false failure
